name: Scarlet hedgehog cactus
desc: Scarlet hedgehog cactus (Echinocereus coccineus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 203 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Echinocereus coccineus (scarlet hedgehog cactus) is a species of hedgehog cactus. It is native to Northern and Central America.
